# HR Onboarding Policy — New Employees

All new employees must complete the onboarding checklist within their first 5 business days:

1. Sign the employment contract and NDA via the HR portal.
2. Complete mandatory security awareness training (module SEC-101).
3. Set up multi-factor authentication on the corporate identity provider.
4. Review the Code of Conduct and acknowledge receipt electronically.
5. Schedule a 30-minute intro meeting with their assigned manager.

Probation period is 3 months. Employees may request remote-work equipment
(laptop, monitor, headset) through the IT Service Desk using ticket category
"Onboarding Equipment". Standard delivery time is 5 business days.

Vacation accrual begins on day 1 at a rate of 2.08 days per month. Sick leave
follows local labor regulations. For questions, contact hr@auralab-corp.example.

# IT FAQ

**How do I reset my password?**
Use the self-service portal at idp.auralab-corp.example/reset. Password resets
require MFA confirmation.

**How do I request VPN access?**
Open a ticket under category "Network Access" with your manager's approval
attached. Standard SLA is 2 business days.

**How do I report a phishing email?**
Forward the email as an attachment to security@auralab-corp.example or use the
"Report Phishing" button in the mail client. Do not click any links.

**Where can I find the asset inventory?**
Asset inventory is maintained in the ITSM system under "CMDB". Access requires
the "IT-Asset-Viewer" role.

# Project Management Guide (Lightweight)

AURA-Lab Corp uses a lightweight agile process:

- Sprints are 2 weeks long.
- Planning happens every other Monday at 10:00.
- Each project must have a one-page charter stored in the PM workspace.
- Status is reported weekly using the RAG (Red/Amber/Green) format — unrelated
  to Retrieval-Augmented Generation, purely a scheduling convention.
- Retrospectives are mandatory at the end of every sprint.

Escalation path for blocked work: team lead → department manager → PMO.

This memo is restricted to Finance leadership and department heads (power/admin
roles). Do not distribute outside AURA-Lab Corp.

from the discontinued Meridian initiative, effective Q4. Headcount for Zephyr-9
